name: WRIGGLE.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you know the toxic runoff and animated slimes in Undercity's canals well. A slime companion feels at home with you.
As Horde, you can trade with local vendors in the canals of Undercity, the Forsaken capital, to obtain the special sludge.

faq.answer: You befriend WRIGGLE. by dancing with the lively little slime. It needs special food to keep up its energy.
A vendor sells Nutritious Slime Sludge in Undercity's canals, where alchemical waste and runoff are common.
faq.q: Where do you find Nutritious Slime Sludge?

faq.answer: Dance with the tired or distracted slime, and it mirrors your playful movements.
faq.q: How do you catch the slime's attention if it seems tired?

faq.answer: Slimes absorb alchemical ooze and sludge around them to stay strong and regain vitality after exertion.
faq.q: Why does the slime feed on sludge?

faq.answer: Once fed its preferred sludge, the revitalized slime bonds with you and seeks to follow you.
faq.q: What happens once the slime is fed?

faq.answer: Alliance travelers face great peril entering Undercity. Vendors in the canals of the Forsaken capital sell the sludge.
faq.q: Can Alliance players easily obtain the sludge?

sections.body: In Undercity, WRIGGLE. joins the dances of friendly travelers. The little slime starts full of energy, but soon tires and needs food to regain its strength.
sections.title: A Dancing Slime

sections.body: You can buy Nutritious Slime Sludge in Undercity's rancid canals. WRIGGLE. absorbs the foul treat and regains its energy. Then it bonds with the one who fed it and is ready to follow its new friend.
sections.title: Sustenance from the Canals

summary: In Undercity, WRIGGLE. dances with travelers, then tires and needs special sludge to recover. After feeding, it follows a new friend.
